summary: ITER 121 — Verified P0 auth regression fix (persistent JWT secret) end-to-end plus the new 'Traccia percorso' WAN button. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (login->requires_2fa->verify-2fa->full token+refresh_token->/api/auth/me 200->/api/clients 200, refresh token rotation, negative auth cases, and deps._load_or_create_persistent_jwt_secret idempotency + db.system_config persistence). Frontend: real UI login with TOTP succeeded, WAN tab trace button navigates to /tools/path-trace?target=<public_ip> with prefilled input, path-trace page defaults (TCP, 443) correct and the no-agent case is handled gracefully with a toast (no crash). No regressions found.

minor.issue: Response returns {token, refresh_token, verified} but no 'user' object (login returns it). Not a bug for the current frontend (TwoFactorPage doesn't use it) — just an API inconsistency worth noting.
Unauthenticated requests return 403 (HTTPBearer default) instead of 401; produces a console 403 error on every /login page load. Cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: deps._load_or_create_persistent_jwt_secret() is correct and race-safe ($setOnInsert upsert on db.system_config _id='jwt_secret'); verified idempotent (same 64-hex value on repeated calls) and the doc persists in Mongo. Env JWT_SECRET still takes priority in preview — no behavior change there.

Final fallback path returns an ephemeral secrets.token_hex(32) when Mongo is unreachable at import time: in that (unlikely) case tokens would again be invalidated per-process. Consider failing fast / retrying instead of silently using an ephemeral key, since this is exactly the failure mode that caused the P0.

NetworkPathDiagnosisPage correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and has loading/error states (toasts) for both agent fetch and trace run; 'Nessun agent connesso' is rendered as a disabled SelectItem (only visible when the dropdown is open) — acceptable, but an inline hint under the select would be clearer.

rca_of_the_issue: Production P0 root cause confirmed by code review: without JWT_SECRET in .env the old code generated a random key at each process start (and per replica), invalidating all previously issued tokens -> 'errore di autenticazione'. The fix persists the secret in db.system_config via an idempotent $setOnInsert upsert; verified stable across calls and persisted in Mongo, while env-provided secret keeps priority (preview unchanged).
